# MonadMate
> Post what you want to do in the next hour and match with someone in the same mall or supermarket. A small MON deposit keeps you both honest.

MonadMate matches people who are physically in the same venue right now and want to do the same thing in the next hour — a meal, an arcade round, or a shopping run. Built on Monad for the EasyA × Consensus Miami Hackathon 2026.

## Key Concepts
- Same venue, same hour: candidates must share a stable venue key, an overlapping time window, and the same intent. Nothing else qualifies, and an empty venue returns no results rather than padded suggestions.
- Commitment deposit: both sides escrow a small amount of MON as a promise about their own attendance — not a bet on the other person. It is returned automatically once both check in.
- Explainable matching: candidates are ranked by preference similarity (30%), fulfilment credit (25%), scene and time-slot habit overlap (20%), window overlap (15%), and safety signals (10%). Every candidate ships with human-readable reasons.
- Hard safety filters: same-gender-only, verified-only, and minimum-reputation preferences are enforced as hard filters in both directions, never as soft ranking.
- Soulbound fulfilment credentials: after a confirmed meetup, a non-transferable credential records the venue category, scene, time, and outcome. It never records the counterparty.
- Follow-through credit: derived from real credential outcomes and hidden until 5 fulfilments exist. It describes past attendance only and is explicitly not a personal-safety guarantee.
- Managed accounts: email or phone login provisions a custodial account with no seed phrase and no gas prompts. Users can link an external wallet to take self-custody at any time.

## API
Base URL: http://localhost:9999/api
Docs: http://localhost:9999/api/docs
OpenAPI: http://localhost:9999/openapi.json

## Key Endpoints
- POST /v1/wallet/login/code — request a passwordless login code (managed account)
- POST /v1/wallet/login/verify — exchange the code for a session
- POST /v1/users/challenge — nonce challenge for wallet signature login
- POST /v1/users/onboard — verify EIP-191 signature, return JWT
- POST /v1/meetups/requests — post an on-site meetup intent
- GET  /v1/meetups/requests/{id}/candidates — ranked same-venue candidates with reasons
- POST /v1/meetups/requests/{id}/propose/{counterpart_id} — accept a candidate
- POST /v1/meetups/matches/{id}/respond — accept or pass (passing carries no penalty)
- POST /v1/stakes — escrow the commitment deposit
- POST /v1/attestations/meetup/initiate — start a check-in
- POST /v1/attestations/meetup/{id}/confirm — confirm with GPS or token
- GET  /v1/credentials/me — list soulbound fulfilment credentials
- GET  /v1/credentials/me/credit — follow-through credit (gated behind 5 fulfilments)
- POST /v1/safety/report — file a report
- POST /v1/safety/block — block a user (bidirectional)

## Open Source Packages
- monadmate-stake-sdk: pip install monadmate-stake-sdk
- monadmate-reputation: pip install monadmate-reputation
- monadmate-x402: pip install monadmate-x402
